'''Wass''' was a boy who had [[The Force/Legends|Force]] potential but was ultimately unworthy of becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and was sentenced to work on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. He organized his friends to fight against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] when they attacked the planet. He had a knack for machines, and helped defeat the droids by plowing through them with farm machinery.
